highlights.title: Your first bot opens #general
highlights.text: Make a space's first bot and #general opens with it, as the Get started checklist says. Later bots open their own chat. On a phone, #general opens while Get started is there.

highlights.title: 24 space icons, and a holo edge on your pick
highlights.text: The space icon picker now has 24 pixel icons, from coffee to code. The one you pick gets a holographic edge, and the preview shines once when you change the icon or colour.

fixes: Get started in your main space now names the starter bots you actually have.
Saying hi to a team, like "hi team!", gets one short hello instead of a reply from every bot.
The README names the starter bots a fresh install really has: Assistant, Researcher and Writer.
Smart results no longer show a "From this reply" label that looked like a button but did nothing.
